outputs.explanation: Panel A is a macroscopic photograph of intestines, not a plot; the check does not apply.
Panel B is a histological micrograph (H&E staining), not a plot; the check does not apply.

Panel C contains two plots: a box plot of total polyp numbers per genotype (box plots are exempt, already showing distribution) and a 3D bar chart of polyp number by diameter and genotype, which shows only bar heights with no individual mouse data points overlaid, despite being derived from averaged per-mouse counts (n=8-18).
Panel D is a Kaplan-Meier survival curve (line plot), which is exempt from requiring individual data point overlays.

Panel E includes a bar chart of relative GTP-bound Rac1/Cdc42 levels with error bars but no individual data points overlaid, despite representing averaged/quantified data from replicate pulldown experiments.
Panel F is an immunohistochemical micrograph series, not a plot; the check does not apply.

Panel G includes a bar chart (relative expression of Asef, pJNK1, MMP9) with error bars and significance asterisks, indicating averaged replicate data, but no individual data points are shown on the bars.
